initialExam.title: CRPF Constable (GD) 2026
initialExam.description: CRPF Constable GD recruitment through SSC GD. CRPF is the largest Central Armed Police Force in India.
initialExam.syllabus: General Intelligence (20Q), General Knowledge (20Q), Elementary Math (20Q), English/Hindi (20Q).
initialExam.examPattern: CBT: 80 questions, 160 marks, 60 min. Physical: Running, Long Jump, High Jump.
initialExam.jobRole: Constable (GD) in Central Reserve Police Force
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → SI → Inspector.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Apply through SSC GD at ssc.gov.in 2. Select CRPF preference
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Ration Allowance, Uniform, Risk Allowance, Medical, Pension
